items.rationale: The police report is required under §2.3.3, but §§3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude the cost of translating it for the claim. The conditional estimate is 68 lines at €2.50 per line.
Sections 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the translator’s working materials and surcharges associated with the excluded translation. The conditional estimate is €10 for one charge.

items.description: Robbery settlement for stolen Tudor watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported armed robbery away from home is covered under §§2.3 and 11.1. Subject to the itemisation required by §7.1.10, the pictured Tudor Royal day-date watch reaches the €2,500 per-item cap and the cash loss exceeds its €500 cap; the €5,000 away-from-home limit does not reduce the €3,000 subtotal, and the single €50 deductible leaves €2,950.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes forwarding and shipping even when billed alongside covered property. The conditional estimate is €26 for one shipping charge.
